calibration.note: all values ms; medians with IQR over 30 runs
calibration.interpretation: external startup numbers carry ~floor overhead identically for every framework; the kernel cross-check bounds the harness spawn-timestamp error; pipe latency bounds marker-arrival skew. Cross-framework startup deltas smaller than the floor's IQR + pipe latency are not meaningful.
